DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
INNER JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_ATM_ACCOUNT]) MX_DT_TBL
ON DATESK = MX_DT;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.ATM_ACCOUNT A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_ATM_ACCOUNT_GROUP_SRC B 
ON COALESCE(A.ACN_ID,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACN_ID,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1
